zh: 修复双屏模式下，从副屏点击「获取授权」时无法打开百度网盘授权页的问题。
更新日版 Game Boy Color 透明卡带模型，调整外壳轮廓、顶部握位和标签槽，细化背面与内部电路板。现有卡带标签可继续使用。
en: Fixed an issue that prevented the Baidu Netdisk authorization page from opening from the secondary screen in dual-screen mode.
Updated the Japanese Game Boy Color cartridge model with a refined transparent shell, top grip, label recess, back details, and internal circuit board. Existing cartridge labels still fit.
